newsitem.title: USA: Giddings & Lewis Inc Q4 net loss widens.
newsitem.headline: Giddings & Lewis Inc Q4 net loss widens.

text.p: (All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)

NOTE: Q4 1996 net loss after $64.1 million pretax charge for Integrated Automation business and $16.0 million in cost of sales adjustments, including additional warranty expenses of $9.7 million and $6.3 million for inventory write-down.
Q4 1995 net loss includes $30.3 million charge.
Before items, Q4 1996 operating income $12.2 million or $0.37 a share vs Q4 1995 operating income of $10.4 million or $0.30 a share.
(All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)
NOTE: Full-year 1996 net loss includes $64.1 million charge and $16.0 million in adjustments take in Q4.
Full-year 1995 net income includes $30.3 million charge.
Full-year 1996 operating income was profit of $37.5 million or $1.10 a share vs year-ago income of $35.4 million or $1.03 a share.
